Witchwargs are related to wargs, but are larger, smarter, and far more dangerous. They are capable of exhaling plumes of freezing breath. When they deign to serve others, they usually reserve this privilege for more dangerous creatures, such as the winter witches of Irrisen. **[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 20 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 18 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 15 [Witchwarg](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3231) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 341 **Perception** +14; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=371)) 30 feet **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +13, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +13, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +11, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +11, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +13, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +12 **Str** +6 **Dex** +4 **Con** +4 **Int** +2 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +2 --- **AC** 23 **Fort** +13 **Ref** +15 **Will** +10 **HP** 70 **Immunities** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) **Weaknesses** [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) 5 Buck [reaction] DC 21 (page 358)
**Avenging Bite** **Trigger** A creature within reach of the warg's jaws attacks one of the warg's allies; **Effect** The warg makes a jaws Strike against the triggering creature. --- **Speed** 40 feet **Melee** jaws +15 ([Cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27)), **Damage** 1d10+6 piercing plus 1d6 cold and [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=46) **Winter Breath** ([Cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The witchwarg breathes a cloud of frost in a 15-foot cone that deals 5d8 cold damage (DC 23 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The witchwarg can't use Winter Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Pack Attack** The witchwarg's Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the witchwarg's allies.
